protocol.attention: full attention; sliding window = None (documented null)

caveats: states l is the output of block l-1; only 14 states are saved (0,1,2,3,5,8,12,16,20,24,28,32,36,39), so the layer profile and the relative depth exponent are measured on 12 intervals, not every block; block 39 (state 40) is only available as dh_last for 24 directions.
the run log quoted a calibration median of ~1.2-1.5; that is the 25th percentile (1.36), not the median (3.78). The file is used throughout.
the stored r_c/pred_T arrays use |dm| (sign-blind); the scorecard uses the signed rule recomputed from m and dm.
only 4 free-run events exist at rho=0.3 and none at rho=0.1, so the scorecard's step-level accuracy is a small-sample statement.
the response-vs-state angle uses 24 directions at the final-norm state and is noisier here (IQR ~8 deg) because ||dh||/||h0|| is only ~1e-4.
phi-4 has no sliding window: window experiments are undefined (null by construction), so no window comparison is made.
